_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#0 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed that an FSI input missing ANY of PROBLEM TYPE / STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC / FLUID DYNAMIC / ALE DYNAMIC / FSI DYNAMIC / CLONING MATERIAL MAP aborts with 'missing required section' from 4C_io_input_file.cpp. Deleting each section in turn from upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml produced five different outcomes and the claimed phrase in none of them (CLAIMED_MISSING_REQUIRED_SECTION=0): only PROBLEM TYPE gives a required-section abort, and its wording is "Required section 'PROBLEM TYPE' not found in input file."; the three field DYNAMIC sections each abort from their own adapter about LINEAR_SOLVER having no default (4C_adapter_str_structure.cpp / 4C_adapter_fld_base_algorithm.cpp / 4C_adapter_ale.cpp); and FSI DYNAMIC is not required at all -- 4C silently falls back to a PARTITIONED scheme with a 200-step budget and runs 13 time steps before dying on a negative fluid Jacobian. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Required section 'PROBLEM TYPE' not found in input file.
no linear solver defined for structural field
no linear solver defined for fluid problem
No linear solver defined for ALE problems

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop deleting sections, so every arm runs the complete upstream deck. All five diagnostics vanish, NOFSI_TIME_STEPS_RUN becomes 10 and EXIT_NOPROB becomes 0 (a forbidden token), so the fixture must go red.
